name: elgg-site-upgrade
description: Upgrade an entire Elgg installation between major versions following the elgg-site-upgrade skill workflow

project.description: Path to the Elgg project being upgraded

port.description: Docker port for the target version environment

steps.title: Assess: detect version and inventory plugins ({{from}} → {{to}})
steps.description: Detect current Elgg version from composer.json/manifest.xml. Map upgrade path. Inventory all plugins (core, composer-managed, custom/private). Categorize each plugin. Find upgraded versions upstream if available.

steps.title: Setup workspace: branches and plugin repos for {{to}}
steps.description: Clone plugin repos to workspace. Symlink into project. Create migrate/elgg-{{to}} branches in project and each plugin repo. Record plugin activation order to mod/.plugin-order.txt.

steps.title: Test baseline: write and run tests on {{from}}
steps.description: GATE: Write PHPUnit tests for each plugin using /elgg-test-writer skill (entity CRUD, registrations, permissions, view rendering). Run tests on current version Docker. All tests must pass before proceeding — this is the safety net. When tracking with beads, pre-migration test issues must block the first migration step, and each migration step must block the next (tests → 3→4 → 4→5 → ...).

steps.title: Capture render-parity golden master on {{from}}
steps.description: GATE PREREQUISITE: before migrating, on the still-running {{from}} stack, capture the route-render golden master (the parity oracle): skills/elgg-site-upgrade/bin/verify-parity.sh capture {{from}} --baseline-dir snapshots/parity --user <admin> --pass <pass>. For a walled-garden site the --user/--pass authenticated crawl is REQUIRED or the baseline is blind to the logged-in surface. Commit snapshots/parity/golden-routes-{{from}}.tsv so the target-version diff has an oracle.

steps.title: Migrate: run automated AST transformations for {{from}} → {{to}}
steps.description: Run: php bin/migrate.php rules/{{from}}-to-{{to}}/manifest.json <plugin> for each plugin. Commit: migrate({{to}}): automated AST transformations.

steps.title: Migrate: apply LLM-guided fixes for {{from}} → {{to}}
steps.description: Run --dry-run --report for each plugin. Apply fixes by category: subtable references, removed functions, entity constructors, raw SQL to QueryBuilder, removed hooks/events, layout views, metadata changes, icon handling, etc. Commit each category separately.

steps.title: Verify PHP syntax after migration
steps.description: Run: find <plugin> -name '*.php' -not -path '*/vendor/*' -exec php -l {} \; for each plugin. Fix any syntax errors.

steps.title: GATE: verify all plugins activate in Docker ({{to}})
steps.description: Boot Docker for target version on port {{port}}. Activate all plugins in order from .plugin-order.txt. ALL must activate without fatal errors. Site must render (curl returns >100 bytes, no Fatal Error in title). No PHP errors in error.log.

steps.title: GATE: PHPUnit tests pass on {{to}}
steps.description: Run PHPUnit tests for each plugin in Docker: docker compose exec elgg vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration mod/<plugin>/tests/phpunit.xml. All tests must pass.

steps.title: GATE: E2E smoke tests pass on {{to}}
steps.description: Run Playwright E2E tests: cd e2e && ELGG_URL=http://localhost:{{port}} npx playwright test. All tests must pass.

steps.title: GATE: render parity {{from}} → {{to}} (no route regressed)
steps.description: GATE (the definition of done): on the booted {{to}} stack, capture its golden master and diff FORWARD against the {{from}} baseline: skills/elgg-site-upgrade/bin/verify-parity.sh check {{from}} {{to}} --baseline-dir snapshots/parity --user <admin> --pass <pass>. Exit 0 = parity; exit 1 = a route that was 2xx/3xx on {{from}} is now 5xx/unreachable. Fix each regression; only intended, reviewed route changes go in snapshots/parity/parity-whitelist.tsv (never blanket-whitelist to make the gate pass). Status parity is the floor — also open the site in a browser and diff against the pre-migration render for CSS/visual drift the status code can't catch.

steps.title: GATE: authenticated write-paths work on {{to}}
steps.description: GATE: render/parity gating is GET-only and never reaches action/CRUD code — write-path breaks (insert/delete_data + relationship signature drift, DBAL ':' param keys, entity save() contract, canWriteToContainer(null)) are latent until an action runs. On the booted {{to}} stack run skills/elgg-site-upgrade/bin/verify-write-paths.sh --base http://localhost:{{port}} --user <admin> --pass <pw> --db-container <db> [--forms-file plugin-forms.txt]. It logs in, creates a group, edits user settings (each verified via DB delta), and GET-sweeps every core + plugin create/edit form for 5xx. Add your plugins' add/edit routes via --forms-file / EXTRA_FORM_ROUTES. All must pass.

steps.title: Fix failures from Docker/PHPUnit/E2E/parity/write-path verification
steps.description: Iterate: fix each failure, commit the fix, re-run the failing gate. Repeat until all gates pass.

steps.title: Expand test coverage for {{to}}
steps.description: Add tests for untested plugin features using /elgg-test-writer skill. Coverage checklist: entity class mapping, entity CRUD, each action tested, each hook/event handler tested, key views render, routes resolve, permissions enforced.

steps.title: Harden PHP dependencies
steps.description: List outdated packages (composer outdated --direct). Upgrade one at a time in risk order: dev deps → utilities → mail/HTTP → image → template → database → framework → Elgg patch. Run all tests after each upgrade. Commit each separately.

steps.title: Harden JS/CSS dependencies
steps.description: List JS deps (composer show | grep npm-asset). Upgrade one at a time in risk order: normalize.css → sprintf-js → cropperjs → jquery-colorbox → jquery-ui → jQuery → tagify. Run PHP + E2E tests after each. Check browser console for JS errors.

steps.title: Final verification: all gates pass for {{to}}
steps.description: Checklist: All version steps complete. All PHP deps at latest stable. All JS/CSS deps at latest stable. Full test suite green (PHPUnit + E2E). Docker boots with all plugins active. No PHP errors in logs. No JS console errors in browser.
